content: Petero ahamagalwa emwa Korineliyo
Omu gishagala ch'eKayizariya haliiri muntu muguma wayirikwaga Korineliyo. Aliiri mukulu w'echigusho ch'abasoda chayirikwaga «Chigusho ch'aBaitaliyana.»
Yeewe n'abantu booshi b'omu mwage, bakengaga Nnamahanga n'okumuyuubaha. Agendaga arhabaala abakene bweneene, anazigaanaga gusaliira Nnamahanga ngasi mango.
Hoofu n'esaa mwenda z'ezuuba, abonekerwa, abona malahika wa Nnamahanga aja omu mwage n'okumuhamagala ntya: «Ego Korineliyo!»
Abeere amuloleereza, ayuubaha, anamubaza ntya: «Nnaweerhu, bichi byabeere?» Malahika amushubiza ntya: «Nnamahanga ayunviirhe amasaala maawe n'oburhabaale bwawe oku bakene anabuyibukire.
Ojaage warhuma abantu eYopa baleerhe Simooni washembulwaga Petero.
Ahandire emw'owundi Simooni w'omulenga omu gukwiza empu, n'enju yaage eri eburhambi bw'enyanja.»
Malahika wamuganiizaga abeere agenda, Korineliyo ahamagala abakozi baage babiri b'akaasi k'omu nju, n'omusoda muguma omu balaala balemaga bamulanga, okenga Nnamahanga.
Amalire kubalira bo byooshi byabeere, abarhuma eYopa.
Olusiku lwakulikiraga, aboola bantu basharhu babeere bachiri omu njira banakola bali bayegeera egishagala, Petero azamuukira elugulu oku nju gusaliira ey'emidi eri hoofu.
Ayunva enzara, anagifiija kulya. Babeere bali bamuvuyira ebiryo, abonekerwa.
Abona empingu echingwirwe n'echintu gishushire n'omwenda munene gifarhiriirwe oku bishimbiri bine chiri charhenga omu chanya n'okuyandagazwa oku daho.
Kw'echoola chintu kwaliiri ngasi buuko bw'enyama z'amagulu mane, enyama zibululuka oku daho, n'enyunyi zibalala omu chaalege.
Omulenge muguma gwava gwamubwira ntya: «Petero, yimanga, baaga onalye.»
Petero ashubiza ntya: «Nangwa Nnaweerhu! Ntashubiraga kulya echintu girhakwaneene kuliibwa, girhanacheesezwe!»
Obwakabiri omulenge gwamubwira ntya: «Echi Nnamahanga acheeseze, wooyo orhagirhoolaga oku girhakwaneene kuliibwa!»
Ebyoola byaaba gasharhu, n'enyuma echoola chintu chaava chazamuulirwa empingu.
Petero abeere achiri achibaza bichi okola kubonekerwa abonaga kuderhere, abantu Korineliyo arhumaga baaja baahika oku mulyango g'okuja omu nju. Babaaga babaziriize embere bamenye enju ya Simooni.
Balegereza, banabaza akonva ahoola ha Simooni washembulwaga Petero ahandire.
Petero abeere ali aganiiza kw'okola kubonekerwa, Muuka-Mutagatiifu amubwira ntya: «Haliira hali balume basharhu bali bagushonda.
Yandagala, onagende haguma nabo buzira kuganganwa, kwenge nyoono nye nabarhumaga.»
Petero ava ayandagala n'okubwira aboola balume ntya: «Nyoono nye muli mwashonda. Bichi birhumire muli hanoola?»

Baashubiza ntya: «Omukulu w'abasoda oyirikwa Korineliyo ye rhurhumire. Ali muntu okwaneene, oyuubaha Nnamahanga, n'aBayaahudi booshi bamuhamiiriza bwinja. Malahika Mutagatiifu amurhegekere oku rhukuleerhe emwage akuyunvirize.»
Petero aja abayankirira omu nju, anabaha aha balaala. Bwacheere eseezi, Petero azuuka, anagenda haguma nabo. Abemeezi baguma b'eYopa bamuherekeza.
Olusiku lwakulikiraga, baagera eKayizariya. Korineliyo aliiri abalinga eyi analaalikire emwage abantu b'omulala gwage, n'abeera baage b'oku murhima.
Petero abeere ahika emwa Korineliyo, Korineliyo aja kumuyankirira, afukama, anayuunama embere zaage omu kumukuuza.
Aliko Petero amuyimanza, anamubwira ntya: «Yimanga, kwenge naani ndi muntu kuguma naawe.»
Petero aja omu nju haguma naye eyi bali baganiira, anabugaana mo abantu banene bachigushire.

Ababwira ntya: «Muyinji mwenyine okw'oMuyaahudi alahiizwe kugwarha obwira n'orhali Muyaahudi changwa okuja omu mwage. Aliko Nnamahanga anyerekere oku birhahemere ogurhoola omuntu nk'orhacheere changwa nk'arhakwaneene kuyegeerwa.
Cho girhumire, egihe mwantumiraga abantu kunshonda, namayinja buzira kuganganwa. Mbahemere muje mwambwira bichi byarhumaga mwampamagala.»
Korineliyo ashubiza ntya: «Hamaagera bunoola siku esharhu, naliiri nasaliira omu mwani, oku gihe nka kinoola ch'esaa mwenda. Ho n'aho omuntu oyambeere emyambalo eri yabaraganya ayimanga embere zaani.
Aderha ntya: ‹Korineliyo, Nnamahanga ayunviirhe amasaala maawe, anayibukire oburhabaale bwawe oku bakene.
Jaaga warhuma abantu eYopa, baje guhamagala Simooni washembulwaga Petero. Ahandire ahaburhambi bw'enyanja, omu nju ya Simooni muhanga w'ogukwiza empu.›
Ho n'aho nava nagurhumira abantu kugushonda, naawe wajirire bwinja okuyinja. Leero rhweshi rhuli hanoola mw'eno saa embere za Nnamahanga yi rhuyunva byooshi Nnaweerhu agurhegekere gurhubwira.»
Enyigirizo za Petero omu nju ya Korineliyo
Petero aj'aderha ntya: «Okuli bunoola namaamenya oku Nnamahanga arhajira kalondoole.
Aliko omu ngasi lubaga, ngasi yeeshi omuyuubaha n'okujira ebikwaneene, Nnamahanga anamuyankirira.
Arhumaga echinwa oku Baisraheeli omu kubabalira oMwazi Mwinja gw'omurhuula kugerera Yeesu Krisitu. Yeewe ye Nnaweerhu w'abantu booshi.
Mwewe, muyinji echizinda kuba omu Yudeeya yooshi gurhonderera eGalilaaya, enyuma za Yohaana kubala okw'abantu babatiizwe.

Muyinji gurhe Nnamahanga agishogaga Yeesu w'eNazareeti gukola akaasi kaage, anamuha Muuka-Mutagatiifu n'obuhashe. Hooshi aliiri agera, aliiri ajira amenja n'ogufumya abantu booshi baliiri omu buja bwa Shetaani. Kwenge Nnamahanga aliiri haguma naye.
Rhuli bahamiiriza ba byooshi ajiraga omu gihugo ch'aBayaahudi n'eYerusaleema. Olaala bayirhaga omu kumubamba oku musalaaba,
aliko Nnamahanga amufuulire olusiku lwa gasharhu. Amuyeerekana oku bantu,
arhali oku lubaga looshi, aliko oku bahamiiriza Nnamahanga abaaga agishogere, oku rhwewe rhwe rhwalyaaga, rhwananywa haguma naye enyuma w'ogufuuka kwage omu bafu.
Arhurhegekere okubalira olubaga n'okuyeerekena oku yeewe ye Nnamahanga ajirire muzuuzi w'abazeene n'abafiire.
Abaleebi booshi bamuha obuula buhamiiriza: ngasi yeeshi omuyemeera, ebyaaha byaage binababalirwa kugerera eziino lyaage.»
Abarhali Bayaahudi bayankirira Muuka-Mutagatiifu
Petero abeere achiri aderha ebyo binwa, Muuka-Mutagatiifu ayandagalira oku booshi baliiri babiyunviriza.
Abemeezi booshi b'aBayaahudi bayinjaga haguma na Petero basoomerwa okubona abarhali Bayaahudi nabo bayandaazwa kw'empaano ya Muuka-Mutagatiifu.
Kwenge baliiri babayunva baderha omu ndimi n'ogukuuza Nnamahanga. Petero aja aderha ntya:
«Abaala bantu bayankirire Muuka-Mutagatiifu kuguma neerhu. Ka hali omuntu wakabalahirira kubatiizibwa omu menji?»
Ava arhegeka oku babatiizwe oku ziino lya Yeesu Krisitu. Baaja bahema Petero abeere haguma nabo siku zigeeke.
